work_summary: Lazy command registration: converted the heaviest eager module imports in tnf-cli to dynamic imports behind cached loader functions, following the existing loadRedisAgentClient pattern.

cli.ts: removed static Orchestrator import (defeated RedisAgentClient laziness; orchestration.js isolated import cost measured at ~2.1s); added loadMCPToolRuntimeService (~770ms MCP SDK+zod), loadStoryService (~230ms supabase), loadPluginsService (~125ms); rewrote 13 call sites to `new (await loader())(...)`.
commands/telegram/index.ts and commands/whatsapp/index.ts: static Telegraf/WhatsappService imports replaced with cached dynamic loaders (~240ms + ~180ms deferred).
bundle-cli.cjs: enabled esbuild splitting (chunks/[name]-[hash]) so dynamic imports become lazily-loaded chunk files instead of being inlined into the eager entry; entry shrank 6123KB -> 857KB.

Restored repo consistency after autonomous fleet commits broke the build mid-session: cli.ts zeroed and auto-committed in bf04b72a2 (restored separately); fleet's rewritten LocalSubdirectorAuthorityService dropped APIs (getConfig/isFirstRun/updateConfig/signLocalSubdirectorIdentity/configLocation) that cli.ts, commands/subdirector.ts, the service test, and commands/agents-run.ts all use; restored both service and agents-run.ts from 5e2caf328 (last consistent set). Fleet's uncommitted agents-run WIP preserved at /tmp/fleet-agents-run-wip-20260901.patch.
